text: dsh-copy-document-preview 是一个面向 DSH 网页客户端的侧栏文件预览增强插件。它在文档预览工具栏加入复制按钮，通过当前会话的 workspace 文件读取接口分页获取文本，再写入浏览器剪贴板；遇到非文本文件时改为复制文件绝对路径。按钮会显示复制中、成功或失败状态，并提供中英文提示。适合需要从 DSH 预览窗取出文档内容或定位二进制文件的用户。安装命令为 dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-copy-document-preview；复制依赖安全上下文中的浏览器剪贴板。

dsh-copy-document-preview adds a copy button to DSH web file previews. It copies previewed text through the current session to the browser clipboard, or copies the absolute path for non-text files. Install with dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-copy-document-preview.
想把 DSH 预览里的文档内容直接复制出来。
能不能从侧栏文件预览一键复制文本或文件路径？
I want to copy the contents of a file while viewing its preview in DSH.
dsh-copy-document-preview 的功能「预览内容复制」：点击文件预览栏的按钮，读取当前会话中的文件文本并复制到剪贴板；非文本文件则复制其绝对路径。

dsh-copy-document-preview README · dsh-copy-document-preview：One-click **copy** button for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar document preview.

The official preview header shows the path, the renderer picker, the wrap toggle
and Reload — but nothing that gets the document out of the pane. This plugin adds
one button there: click it and the previewed file's text is on your clipboard.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-copy-document-preview README · What it does：- **A copy button in the document preview header**, rendered after the preview's own
  controls and after *Open in app*.
- **Copies the whole file**, not just the part the preview has loaded: the plugin reads
  the file through the harness's own paged file Remote (`remote.workspaceFiles.read`),
  the same reader the preview itself uses, and never bypasses the Session that owns
  the file.
- **Binary files copy their path instead.** For a PDF, image or Office document the
  Host reports `workspace-file/not-text`; the button then copies the file's absolute
  path and says so, rather than failing silently.
- **Clear feedback.** A check mark for two seconds after a successful copy, a warning
  mark and a reason on failure, both announced to assistive technology.
- **Text files copy their text.** Markdown, plain text and code files are copied as
  their source text; the copy does not include the preview's line numbers.

dsh-copy-document-preview README · What it does：| Preview | What lands on the clipboard |
|---|---|
| Plain text, Markdown, code, logs | The file's full text |
| CSV / TSV / JSON / YAML | The file's full text |
| PDF, image, Office (`.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`), zip, binary | The file's absolute path |

dsh-copy-document-preview README · Install：From the npm registry:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-copy-document-preview
```

Straight from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shellpower96/dsh-copy-document-preview
```

If your machine has no GitHub SSH key, use the HTTPS form of the same repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/shellpower96/dsh-copy-document-preview.git#main
```

dsh-copy-document-preview README · Install：Then restart `dsh web`. Alternatively install it from the Plugin Market or the
Plugin Manager, which also enables the bundle for you.

Remove it with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-copy-document-preview
```

dsh-copy-document-preview README · How it works：The plugin has no build step and no runtime dependencies. Its browser half registers
one entry in the document toolbar's additive list slot
(`sidebar.right.tab.document.actions`), a slot that only appends, so no existing
control is replaced.

dsh-copy-document-preview README · How it works：- The slot hands the entry the file's `absolutePath`; the Session id, the locale
  function and the standard hooks come from the slot runtime.
- Reading uses `remote.workspaceFiles.read(sessionId, path, { offset }, signal)`, the
  same Remote the preview uses, so the file is read with the previewing Session's own
  authority and the host's byte and line limits still apply.
- The browser half never imports a Harness Client package, styles itself with the
  host's `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens (so it follows light and dark mode), and routes
  every visible string through the client locale service (English and Simplified
  Chinese).
- Nothing is written outside the plugin's own component, and the button is the only
  DOM it owns.

dsh-copy-document-preview README · Limitations：- The clipboard write uses `navigator.clipboard`, so the page must be a secure
  context (`https://` or `http://127.0.0.1`) and focused. There is no
  `execCommand('copy')` fallback.
- A file larger than the host's per-page limits (`maxLines`, `maxBytes`) fails with
  the host's own `too-large` error, and so does a file with more than 200 pages.
- Binary files copy their path; the plugin cannot extract text from them.
